method: Read and compared all 381 report-selected Korean page sources and targets as aligned front-matter fields and paragraphs. Deduplicated identical source/target pairs (including shared paragraph variants and collection reasons) to avoid redundant review. Independently compared all Markdown link destinations. No repository files edited.
limitations: AI text/source review, not a native-speaker human certification.
No fresh image inspection: visible-image facts were compared to the authoritative source descriptions, not independently verified against media.
UI messages and shared YAML fields assigned to another reviewer; not included in this page review.
Source inaccuracies already present in the authoritative source were not rewritten.
No assertions about runtime browser behavior from this translation review.

findings.source: The current result uses the supplied silhouette with the built-in image tool, not ControlNet.
findings.oldText: 현재 결과는 ControlNet이 아닌 내장 이미지 도구에서 제공된 실루엣을 사용했습니다.
findings.suggestedText: 현재 결과는 제공된 실루엣을 ControlNet이 아닌 내장 이미지 도구에 입력해 만들었습니다.
findings.reason: 原译文中的“내장 이미지 도구에서 제공된 실루엣”将 supplied silhouette 修饰为内置图像工具提供的剪影，改变了用户提供参照图与生成工具的关系。源页面 How to use 明确要求上传肖像导引图；建议明确将提供的剪影输入内置图像工具。

resolution.method: Exact pending candidates separately compared with their sources by AI Codex root, then applied with locale:import and locale:promote dry-run/apply. Baseline hashes in this audit describe the pre-correction text.
